Ensuring Compliance, Enhancing Care

Healthcare organizations face strict regulations to ensure the safety, security, and quality of patient care. At Binary Bridge Technology Services, we specialize in ADHICS (Abu Dhabi Health Information and Cyber Security Standard) medical inspection and consultancy, providing expert guidance to help you achieve and maintain compliance with these critical standards.
[/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column]
[/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column]

Why Choose Us?

The Abu Dhabi Healthcare Information and Cyber Security (ADHICS) standard is a mandatory framework established by the Department of Health – Abu Dhabi (DoH) to protect patient data and enhance cybersecurity. It applies to all licensed healthcare entities in Abu Dhabi, enforcing strict, 11-domain compliance to safeguard health information, ensuring confidentiality, integrity, and availability.+3 Key Aspects of Abu Dhabi Health Sector Information Security:
ADHICS Compliance: All healthcare facilities—hospitals, clinics, and pharmacies—must comply with ADHICS regulations, which are designed to protect against cyber threats and ensure secure data handling, particularly within the Malaffi health information exchange.
Key Security Domains: The framework mandates information security governance, risk management, access control, data protection (encryption at rest/transit), incident response, and physical security.
AAMEN Programme: The Department of Health oversees these initiatives through the AAMEN programme, which evaluates facilities against international security standards.
Malaffi Security: Malaffi uses advanced security protocols, including encryption and strict access controls for authorized healthcare professionals.
Key Security Controls: Access Management: Strict governance ensures only authorized personnel access patient records.
Data Protection: Implementation of encryption for all sensitive health data.
Threat Management: Regular risk assessments and incident response planning are required.

[/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column]

Our Services

[/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column width=”1/3″]

ADHICS Compliance Assessment

  • Comprehensive evaluation of your healthcare facility’s compliance with ADHICS requirements.
  • Identification of gaps and vulnerabilities in data management and cybersecurity.
  • Detailed reports with actionable recommendations for improvement.

[/vc_column][vc_column width=”1/3″]

Policy and Procedure Development

  • Creation of tailored policies to meet ADHICS standards.
  • Documentation of processes for data security, patient confidentiality, and IT governance.
  • Employee training materials to ensure adherence across your organization.

[/vc_column][vc_column width=”1/3″]

Inspection Readiness

  • Pre-inspection audits to ensure your facility is prepared for official assessments.
  • Mock inspections to familiarize staff with compliance procedures.
  • Guidance on addressing and resolving findings from previous inspections.

[/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column]
[/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column width=”1/2″]

Cybersecurity Solutions

  • Implementation of advanced security measures to protect sensitive medical data.
  • Regular security audits to identify and mitigate threats.
  • Training programs to build awareness and preparedness against cyber risks.

[/vc_column][vc_column width=”1/2″]

Consultancy and Support

  • Ongoing consultancy to maintain compliance as standards evolve.
  • Expert advice on integrating ADHICS requirements into daily operations.
  • Support for IT infrastructure upgrades and process optimization.

[/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_separator color=”blue” style=”shadow”][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column]

Secure Your Healthcare Facility Today

[/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_separator color=”blue” style=”shadow”][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_column_text]Meeting ADHICS standards isn’t just a requirement—it’s a commitment to excellence in healthcare. Let us help you navigate the complexities of compliance and safeguard the trust of your patients.

Contact us today to schedule a consultation and learn more about our services![/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row]
